scenario_description:
Objective: Move the unused prepaid wash to a machine that can actually take Nicolette's winter quilt today.
Emerging Need: Loading has started, but the small washer cannot turn the bulky quilt freely and the cycle has not begun.
Decision Context: Retrieve the quilt care requirements, larger compatible machine, laundry-card ID and free unused-cycle transfer rule. Arrange a suitable transfer without a second payment or unsafe overloading.
Consequence: After the compatible machine is occupied for the rest of the day, today's intended quilt wash cannot use the offered alternative; the credit itself remains available.

parameter.title: Wash the winter quilt at the basement laundry
parameter.content: Take the winter quilt and laundry card for a midday wash. Do not force bulky bedding into a drum.

parameter.description: Six-dollar prepaid wash credit for the co-op laundry card; payment completed, wash not yet used.

parameter.content: The6 wash credit is on my card. I started putting the winter quilt into the South washer, but it fills the drum tightly and cannot turn freely. I stopped before starting a cycle; nothing has been washed or debited from the card.

parameter.subject: Courtyard washer opening and unused-credit transfers
parameter.body: The courtyard West front-loader is available at 13:00; its later bookings fill the rest of today. Before 12:45, residents may ask the laundry desk to transfer one unused prepaid wash to that machine at no extra charge using card ID and receipt. Check garment requirements and machine capacity before requesting; the center-agitator machine is a different appliance.

parameter.content: I can help carry the dry quilt to the courtyard room at 12:50. It is still in your basket. If the West machine meets the care label, I can stay while you load it; I am not putting it into the small drum again.

parameter.subject: West washer opening assigned
parameter.body: The 12:45 reservation cutoff passed and the 13:00 West washer slot went to another resident. The compatible large machine is booked for the rest of today. Your unused6 credit remains on the original card for a later wash; no refund, extra charge or new subscription has been applied.
